properties.name: Hexagons Tirol
properties.rule: Land Tirol excluding district Lienz, intersected with longitude <= 12.0636 degrees east (Wörgl city-office meridian).

cutoff_point.name: Wörgl Stadtamt, Bahnhofstraße 15; adopted town-centre reference
cutoff_point.source_precision: Municipal website publishes latitude/longitude to 4 decimal places; this longitude is adopted exactly.

source.title: Verwaltungsgrenzen (VGD), Tirol
source.resolution: Un-simplified cadastral-derived VGD coordinates. No extra cartographic generalization applied here. Source is not a legal cadastral boundary determination.

processing.source_selection: BL=Tirol; exclude PB=Lienz (BKZ=707); dissolve remaining 288 cadastral polygons, preserving all components/holes.
processing.projection: axis order change (2D) + Inverse of Austria Lambert + MGI to WGS 84 (3) + axis order change (2D)
processing.projection_pipeline: proj=pipeline step inv proj=lcc lat_0=47.5 lon_0=13.3333333333333 lat_1=49 lat_2=46 x_0=400000 y_0=400000 ellps=bessel step proj=push v_3 step proj=cart ellps=bessel step proj=helmert x=577.326 y=90.129 z=463.919 rx=5.137 ry=1.474 rz=5.297 s=2.4232 convention=position_vector step inv proj=cart ellps=WGS84 step proj=pop v_3 step proj=unitconvert xy_in=rad xy_out=deg
processing.clip: Planar intersection in EPSG:4326 with longitude <= cutoff; latitude unrestricted. Retain ALL polygon parts. No simplification or coordinate rounding.

properties.display_contract: 5 m display DEM and detailed orthophotos. NN snow predictions remain approximately 30 m. Outside-area prediction density is not prescribed.
properties.asset_status: Intended display area, not proof of complete existing imagery/DEM or production bake coverage.
